heat_note: Without the rest rule, cut still at 70 C, 25 C room: the right-knee reading reaches 55 C at 1.16 min and 60 C at 1.37 min. The case reaches 49 C at 1.40 min and peaks at 61.06 C. The case does not reach 62 C in that 25 C run. After the cut unloads the knee the case cools, and at 90 min it is 27.68 C (sim pass only). The 32 C room with the same cut peaks the case at 61.90 C. Sim pass only. With the torque cut raised to 200 C on the typical corner, the reading reaches 200.01 C and the case peaks at 179.24 C (sim pass only). That stand-in cut then unloads the servo. The high-side corner with the same 200 C stand-in ends at a 176.86 C case, last-10-min rise 0.048 C, reading max 198.32 C (sim pass only). That is the balance this model reaches when the sheet cut is not allowed to hide it. The 55/45 guard, on the 10 min current, walks 14.0 percent of the 90 min at 25 C and 9.0 percent at 32 C (sim pass only). PR 86 reported 38.8 percent and 20.1 percent on the Kt-scaled old log. Guard case peak is 50.31 C at 25 C and 51.01 C at 32 C (sim pass only). The 90 min samples are 47.93 C and 48.70 C, and the last 10 min move those samples by 0.198 C and -0.976 C. The 32 C guard cooled over the last 10 min. Both peaks are above the cited 49 C PLA edge and under the cited 62 C PETG point. Putting the 0.30 V Castle drop back leaves the case peak at 61.06 C against 61.06 C on the wire (sim pass only). The knee number does not move with that trunk drop.
breaker_note: No limb sample in these walks is above 7.23 A. The highest limb peak is 6.411 A, on the 0.40 m/s jog, typical, left_leg (sim pass only). That peak is under the cited ILIM window, 7.23 A to 9.07 A, so the 600 nF timer does not start. A normal walk does not trip this breaker, and the 0.40 m/s jog does not trip it either. The 100 ms average is not the basis of that call. Calc only against the cited limits, on sim pass only currents.
